## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm run e2e` pass
- [ ] New or changed texts exist in all 25 languages and follow the glossary
- [ ] Loading, empty and error states; inline validation; destructive actions confirm
- [ ] Keyboard and screen reader still work (the axe tests stay clean)
- [ ] `dist/` rebuilt and committed (`npm run build`)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated for anything users or implementers notice
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
